name: br-estimated-tax
description: Brazil calendar 2026 Carnê-Leão monthly personal income tax for resident individuals receiving qualifying taxable receipts from individuals or abroad. Covers classification, cash receipt month, current progressive table and separate 2026 reduction, legal versus simplified deductions, livro-caixa conditions and within-year carry, precise foreign exchange, DARF 0190 timing/generation and verified payment evidence, ordinary late charges and annual reconciliation. Trigger on Carnê-Leão, recolhimento mensal obrigatório, DARF 0190, livro-caixa, Brazilian estimated personal tax, foreign freelance receipts and monthly tax reduction. Includes recomputing legal/simplified decision and professional-income examples plus all earlier edge cases/tests. Excludes corporate IRPJ estimates, complete annual-return preparation and specialist nonresident, financial, crypto, capital-gain, treaty and disputed-deduction computations not established here.
